title: Feature Request: Dedicated “Sport Mode” UI Toggle for Exercise Support in AAPS
symptom: Physical activity significantly affects glucose dynamics in type 1 diabetes, and managing these changes safely with AAPS currently depends on manual Automations, which are complex, error-prone, and difficult to explain or delegate. Automations often fail to trigger if another Temp Target or profile % change is already active, requiring multiple manual workarounds and conditions.
evidence_quote: Automations often fail to trigger if another Temp Target (TT) or profile % change is already active.
